about: Rules for the TTS save (TTS/Impossibility Simulator.json), written by audit.py. A deck's cards are the repo PNGs matched by rule.folders (globs: * stays inside one folder) plus rule.include, minus rule.exclude. partial: a hand-picked subset (only its own cards are refreshed; card_list = its distinct cards); with add_new_since (a commit) it also gains every rule card the save at that commit lacked (renames followed; a card moved to other stars moves to that add_new_since deck; nothing is recorded, so a card taken out by hand comes back unless the rule excludes it). count: the usual copies per card; odd_counts (per deck): cards at another count. rule null: needs a decision (see AUDIT.md).
